summary: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next QAD FP4-CSF checkpoints start: the PLE storage dtype is read from the checkpoint the serving directory points at
compatibility: Only FP4-CSF serving directories change; other checkpoints resolve the PLE dtype as before.
details: When the checkpoint config omits the PLE storage dtype, vLLM reads it from the safetensors headers of the model directory. An FP4-CSF serving directory holds metadata only, so the QAD checkpoint's NVFP4 PLE table was taken for BF16 and loading stopped with a PLE shard shape mismatch. The dtype is now read from the tensors under the CSF checkpoint root.
